quantra_Period.description:
Canonical period type used across APIs. Both fields are presence-required:
a bare `n` would silently default to 0 and an omitted `unit` would silently
mean Months, so a forgotten value is a 400 naming the field rather than a
silent (0 Months) tenor.

quantra_FlowInterest.description: Interest cash flow with fixing and accrual metadata.

quantra_FlowsWrapper.description: Wrapper for a single flow in a collection.

quantra_Fixing.description: Historical index fixing for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexDef.description: Complete index definition. Registered once per request, referenced by id.

index_type.description:
IBOR or Overnight. Determines QuantLib class used. Presence-required: an
omitted value is a 400, never the silent Ibor default.

tenor.description: Tenor period (e.g., 6 Months for Euribor 6M, 0 Days for overnight).

fixing_days.description: Fixing days (e.g., 2 for Euribor, 0 for SOFR/ESTR). Presence-required.

end_of_month.description:
End of month rule (IBOR only, ignored for overnight). Presence-required:
absent-vs-false silently changes money-market schedule dates.

fixings.description: Past fixings needed for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexRef.description: Reference to an IndexDef by its id.

quantra_QuantoSpec.description:
Quanto treatment of one basket underlying whose currency differs from the
note currency: the note pays in its own currency the performance of an
index quoted in another one, so the simulated drift of that index is
r_note - q - rho * sigma_S * sigma_FX (QuantLib QuantoTermStructure) while
the index keeps its own units. Present iff the underlying's currency
differs from `StructuredNote.currency` (400 either way otherwise: a
quanto block on a same-currency underlying, or none on a foreign one).

discounting_curve.description:
Id of the discount curve of the UNDERLYING's currency in
pricing.rates.curves: the risk-neutral drift of the underlying in its
own currency (r_local in the quanto adjustment). The note-currency
curve is `StructuredNote.discounting_curve`. Required.

fx_spot_id.description:
Id of the `FxSpotSpec` in pricing.fx.spots for the underlying's
currency against the note currency, in either direction (the engine
inverts when base/quote are the other way round). Required.

fx_volatility_id.description:
Id of the `VolSurfaceSpec` (BlackVolSpec payload, Constant or term)
in pricing.volatility.vol_surfaces holding the volatility of that FX
rate; used only for the quanto drift adjustment. Required.

fx_underlying_correlation.description:
Correlation between the underlying and the FX rate (underlying
currency per unit of note currency, i.e. the rate that rises when
the note currency strengthens against the underlying's currency), in
[-1, 1]. A scalar input: the FX rate is not simulated and this
correlation is not read from the correlation matrix. Presence-
required (a bare double would silently mean 0 = no adjustment).

quantra_BasketUnderlying.description:
One underlying of a basket: an equity index (or share) from the shared
equity market data, its volatility, the level it was struck at, and the
closes already observed for a seasoned note.

underlying_id.description:
Id of the `EquityUnderlyingSpec` in pricing.equity.equity_underlyings
(spot quote, dividend curve, currency). Required.

volatility_id.description:
Id of the `VolSurfaceSpec` (BlackVolSpec payload) in
pricing.volatility.vol_surfaces: constant, term, or strike x expiry
surface (a surface makes the simulation local-vol and requires
`MonteCarloSpec.steps_per_year`). Required.

initial_level.description:
Strike fixing from the term sheet: the closing level on the strike
date that every performance S(t) / initial_level is measured against.
Presence-required and > 0.

quanto.description:
Quanto block. Present iff the underlying's currency differs from the
note currency (see `QuantoSpec`).

historical_levels.description:
Closing levels on past observation dates (seasoned notes): one
`Fixing` (date, value > 0) per observation event whose
`observation_date` is on or before the valuation date and that
carries a trigger. Events before the valuation date are resolved from
these, never simulated; a past observation without a level is a 400
naming the date and the underlying. Accrual-only events need no
level. Levels on other dates are ignored.

quantra_ObservationEvent.description:
One date of the note's life. Which tests run at an event is decided by
which triggers are present; the coupon of the event is `coupon`
(fraction of notional). The basket performance perf = rule over
S_i(observation_date) / initial_level_i, and every test is "perf >=
trigger" (triggers are fractions of the initial level: 1.0 = 100%).

autocall_trigger present, coupon_trigger absent (classic autocall):
the coupon test IS the call test. perf >= autocall_trigger: notional
plus this event's coupon plus every unpaid coupon in the memory is
paid on `payment_date` and the note ends. Otherwise nothing is paid
and, with `CouponRule.memory`, `coupon` joins the memory.
autocall_trigger present, coupon_trigger present (Phoenix with a call):
coupon test first: perf >= coupon_trigger earns this event's coupon
plus the memory (paid on `payment_date`, or held until the next call
when `CouponRule.pay_only_on_call`); otherwise the coupon joins the
memory. Then the call test: perf >= autocall_trigger pays the
notional plus everything held, on `payment_date`, and the note ends.
autocall_trigger absent, coupon_trigger present (coupon-only date):
the coupon test only, as above; the note cannot end here.
both absent (accrual-only period):
nothing is observed and nothing is paid: `coupon` is added to the
memory. This encodes a snowball coupon that accrues from the strike
date while the first observation is later (a 7% semi-annual coupon
first observed at 12 months pays 2 x 7% on the first call). Requires
`CouponRule.memory` = true (400 otherwise: nothing could carry the
coupon) and `payment_date` absent (400 when present).

The last event is the final observation: its tests run as above, and
when the note has not ended there the capital test of
`CapitalProtection` runs on the same perf and the redemption is paid on
`StructuredNote.maturity_payment_date`. A final event with no trigger at
all is a 400. Events must be in strictly increasing `observation_date`
order; events on or before the valuation date are resolved from
`BasketUnderlying.historical_levels` and never simulated.

observation_date.description:
Date the basket is observed (closing levels), ISO. Required. For an
accrual-only event (no triggers) nothing is observed: the date is
nominal and only orders the event among the others.

payment_date.description:
Date a coupon or call triggered here is paid, ISO, on or after
`observation_date`. Required (400) whenever `autocall_trigger` or
`coupon_trigger` is present; must be absent for an accrual-only
event.

coupon_trigger.description:
Coupon trigger as a fraction of the initial level; perf >= trigger
earns the coupon. Absent = no coupon test of its own (with an
`autocall_trigger` the coupon is earned by the call test; with
neither trigger the event is accrual-only).

coupon.description:
Coupon of this period as a fraction of notional (0.07 = 7%).
Required (400) when `coupon_trigger` is present or the event is
accrual-only. With only an `autocall_trigger` it may be absent: the
event then carries no coupon of its own and a call pays the notional
plus the memory only.

quantra_CouponRule.description: How coupons that were earned or missed carry over between events.

memory.description:
True: a coupon not paid at its event (test failed, or held because
`pay_only_on_call`) is added to a memory that is paid in full with
the next coupon that is paid; the memory is a sum of coupon amounts,
so events may carry different coupons. False: a missed coupon is
lost. Presence-required.

pay_only_on_call.description:
True (Athena / snowball): coupons are paid only when the note ends
(a call, or the final event); an earned coupon at a non-calling
event is held in the memory. False (Phoenix): an earned coupon is
paid on its event's `payment_date`. Presence-required.

quantra_CapitalProtection.description:
Capital protection at the final observation. With perf the basket
performance on the final observation date (or, with DailyClose
monitoring, breach = any close below the barrier over the life), the
redemption is notional x 1 when the barrier holds and
notional x (1 - participation x max(put_strike - perf_final, 0)) when it
is breached, paid on `StructuredNote.maturity_payment_date`.

barrier.description:
Barrier as a fraction of the initial level (0.6 = 60%); the capital
is at risk when perf < barrier. Presence-required and in (0, 1].

monitoring.description: When the barrier is tested. Presence-required.

put_strike.description:
Strike of the embedded put as a fraction of the initial level
(1.0 = loss measured from 100%, the "1-for-1" of a factsheet).

knocked_in.description:
Whether a DailyClose barrier has already been breached before the
valuation date. Presence-required (400) when `monitoring` is
DailyClose and any event precedes the valuation date (the engine
cannot infer it from `historical_levels`, which hold observation
dates only); must be absent otherwise.

quantra_UpsideParticipation.description:
Optional upside at the final observation when the note has not called:
adds `participation * max(perf - strike, 0)` of the notional, capped at
`cap` when present. Expresses bonus certificates, capped participation
notes and twin-win structures; absent for a plain autocallable.

strike.description: Strike as a fraction of the initial level. Presence-required.

participation.description: Participation in the performance above the strike. Presence-required.

cap.description:
Maximum upside as a fraction of the notional (0.3 = at most +30%).
Absent = uncapped.

quantra_MonteCarloSpec.description:
Monte Carlo settings. Every price carries its standard error, path
count and seed, and Greeks are computed by bump-and-reprice on the same
random stream.

paths.description:
Number of simulated paths (antithetic pairs count as two paths).
Presence-required and > 0; a power of two is recommended with Sobol.

seed.description: Seed of the random sequence (Sobol scrambling / Mersenne Twister).

antithetic.description: Antithetic variates (every Gaussian draw is also used negated).

brownian_bridge.description: Brownian-bridge ordering of the draws (recommended with Sobol).

steps_per_year.description:
Time steps per year of the simulation grid between observation
dates. Required (400) when any underlying's volatility is a strike x
expiry surface (local-vol evolution) or the capital barrier is
monitored DailyClose; otherwise must be absent and the grid is the
observation dates only (exact lognormal steps). Between observation
dates the processes evolve with log-Euler steps of 1/steps_per_year
years. A DailyClose barrier is tested on the simulated closes only:
set this to the index's trading days per year (about 252); fewer
steps under-sample the barrier and bias the price. No continuity
correction (Broadie-Glasserman-Kou) is applied, because the barrier
is discrete by contract.

quantra_StructuredNote.description:
A structured note on a basket of equity indices: a strip of observation
events (autocall and/or coupon tests on the basket performance), a coupon
carry rule, and capital protection at maturity. Classic and snowball
autocalls, low-hurdle finals, Phoenix coupons, step-down triggers and
geared puts are all configurations of these fields; there is one payoff
walk, not one product per shape. Priced by Monte Carlo under correlated
Black-Scholes (or local-vol) dynamics with quanto drift adjustments,
discounted on `discounting_curve` plus `funding_spread_bp`.

trade_id.description: Trade identifier echoed in the response. Required.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code of the note currency (coupons, redemption, NPV).
Required.

notional.description:
Notional (denomination x units); coupons and the redemption are
fractions of it. Presence-required and > 0.

underlyings.description:
The basket. Required; at least one entry; ids distinct; with two or
more entries the set of `underlying_id`s must equal the labels of the
correlation matrix `correlation_id`.

performance_rule.description:
Reduction of the underlyings' performances to the tested perf.
Presence-required.

events.description:
The note's dates in strictly increasing `observation_date` order; the
last one is the final observation. Required; at least one entry.

capital.description: Capital protection tested at the final observation. Required.

maturity_payment_date.description:
Date the redemption is paid when the note reaches the final
observation without a call, ISO, on or after the final
`observation_date`. Required.

discounting_curve.description:
Id of the note-currency discount curve in pricing.rates.curves
(OIS or funding curve). Required.

funding_spread_bp.description:
Issuer funding spread in basis points added to `discounting_curve`
as a flat zero spread (QuantLib ZeroSpreadedTermStructure) for
discounting every cash flow. 0 = discount on the curve as is.

correlation_id.description:
Id of the `CorrelationMatrixSpec` in pricing.correlations.matrices;
its labels must be exactly the basket's underlying ids. Required
(400) when the note has two or more underlyings; must be absent (400)
with exactly one underlying, which is simulated on a 1 x 1 unit
matrix (a `CorrelationMatrixSpec` lists at least two labels).

upside.description: Upside participation at the final observation. Absent = none.
